fresh_result: Version-aligned ABL1 source leads were enumerated and compared against the exact payload/disassembly without source identity claims. A candidate UCLK/FCLK/divider function is promoted only if >=2 structural binary anchors are available; otherwise the lead remains unproven and the next blocker is recorded.
limits: No cross-channel minimum synchronization assumption, no MHz/unit claim, no source-to-binary identity claim, no firmware/hardware/runtime action and no broad absence inference.
